evidence: One typical ALD cycle includes four alternative steps: TDMASn feed/N 2 purge/O3 feed/N2 purge with the exposure time of 1 s/15 s/15 ms/15 s, respectively. With the precursor of TDMASn keeping on 60 /C14 C and the reaction temperature of the chamber maintaining on 100 /C14 C, the growth rate of SnO2 is ~1.2 Å, which is consistent with the previous reported values.
